name: Query String Parser / Builder
description: Parse a URL or query string into a readable key/value table, or build a query string from scratch with automatic encoding — including correct handling of repeated keys.

faq.question: Can I paste a full URL, not just the query string?
faq.answer: Yes — the parser looks for the first "?" and ignores everything before it (the scheme, domain, and path), and also strips a trailing #fragment if there is one, so pasting the whole address bar contents works fine.

faq.question: What happens with a repeated key like ?tag=a&tag=b?
faq.answer: Both entries are shown, in order, rather than merged into one — some frameworks use repeated keys to represent a list (e.g. multiple selected filter values), and collapsing them into a single key/value pair would lose that information.
